title: Dis' Light Cobblemon Magic Pack
description: A modpack made with the intention of mixing cobblemon with a few magic and decoration-based mods. It's meant to allow people to enjoy cobblemon while also doing fun magic stuff with their newfound pokemon friends.
body:
A small modpack that combines Cobblemon with decor and magic mods. Includes Cobblemon with a few addons. Some other notable mods include:
- Easy Magic, Anvils, Piglins, Villagers
- Enchanted Witchcraft!
- Pastel
- Terralith
- Waystones
- Sophisticated Storage

Pastel provides a large amount of progression alongside Cobblemon whilst also providing tools similar to tech-based mods. 

Enchanted Witchcraft allows you to get more hands-on with effects centered around the player, such as poppets, brews and rituals. Perfect for cottage-core stuff!

Multiple chisel mods were added for the sake of freshening up everything as well. Decorate builds with modded themes in tandem with your cobblemon creations.

All the Easy mods make certain chores (such as villager job reshuffling) a TON easier so you can get to building things faster!
